# Half 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Half:Int32 value:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | In | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The Half.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Half, a 16-bit real with about 3 digits that goes up to 65504. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. Larger numbers become infinity. A Half is calculated with as a `Float`, so it is made for storing many numbers in little space, for example in a bank.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which only have the 32-bit real (`Float`).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
h:Half = Half(1.5)
Print h * 2
Print Half(0.1) = 0.1
```

```text
3.0
0
```
